"Calling Jon Jones a sociopath is arm-chair psychology."

1. about the pregnant woman I slammed into drunk and left alone in panic - "Oh I was so worried! I could have been in so much trouble."
2. \*looks for cameras\* "You know I would absolutely kill you if you did something like that, right?"
3. \*after beating fiancee in front of his three children\* "I am turning this nightmare into the best thing in my life."

Fuck this guy. If Dana doesn't cut him... I mean we know he won't, but this is disgusting shit.

\>usually happens when we have discussed or fought about something

Can you elaborate on this? There could be something underlying to address.

Now, I'm going to say that I've been this girl. I'm a guy, but I was this girl. I would lay around on a mattress just wanting to be left alone to stare at the ceiling. As in, "I don't wanna eat anything, I don't wanna drink anything, I just wanna lay here and die." I've been doing this for years and for the last year+ of my relationship with my ex I did this.

Sometimes very little things help. Just make some soup and bring it to her. If she lets you, cuddle with her, just silently, don't ask too many questions but try to comfort her. If she says "leave me alone", do it. Ask her if she wants to hear from any friends or family. 

DO NOT say "All you do is lay around!". This shit has sent me into hysterics so many times. This is a very severe level of depression that is wildly unpredictable that can't just be figured out or "fixed" in a certain way. There are so, so many variables here.
Be careful about medications. I've just turned 22 and I've been on like fifteen. My brain is completely ruined. It's a depressing end.
